<!-- pr-reviewer: 259262bb8d810e2d9f79d91e23d58d649a097350 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The double-click half of #1278 works; the "log still shows in a terminal" and "a start-up failure is still visible" halves are not met by this diff.

**What looks good**
- `#![cfg_attr(windows, windows_subsystem = "windows")]` is in `crates/ui/src/main.rs:4`. I read the PE header of the debug exe built from this head (not run): Subsystem = 2 (GUI). It covers debug and release alike, so a debug build is GUI-subsystem too (release not built; same attribute).
- Small, confined to `#[cfg(windows)]`; the non-Windows `attach_parent_console` is an empty fn. `camcraft-cli` untouched. One `unsafe` call with a SAFETY comment; the return value is ignored on purpose and no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`.
- No new dependency: `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock` unchanged (one kernel32 `extern` declaration instead of `windows-sys`). Decision note present, body is honest about what was not tried.

**Local results (merged with main 0757563d, Windows)**
- `cargo build -p camcraft-ui` (debug): OK.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No tests exist or can exist for this; the GUI exe was not run.

**Requested before merge**
1. Terminal output after attach (`main.rs:12-19`, expected point 2). `AttachConsole` only connects the process to a console; it does not give a GUI-subsystem process valid standard handles. Rust's `std::io::stderr` (what `logging::init` writes to, `crates/app/src/logging.rs`) uses `GetStdHandle`, which stays NULL when the exe was started from a terminal without redirection, so the log most likely still goes nowhere, i.e. the PR's stated purpose is not achieved. The usual fix: after a successful attach, for each of STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE / STD_ERROR_HANDLE whose `GetStdHandle` is NULL or invalid, open `CONOUT$` (`CreateFileW`) and `SetStdHandle` it. That same test ("handle is NULL/invalid") is what leaves `> log.txt 2>&1` and pipes alone, which the issue requires and the PR does not do or discuss today. I could not confirm this by running the app (no GUI launches), so please try it on Windows; if I am wrong about the behaviour, the PR body should say it was tried and worked.
2. Start-up failure with no console (expected point 4). Every refusal path (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs:271,280,289,311`, plus window/GPU creation in `run_windowed`) only does `diag_warn!` to stderr and returns an exit code; there is no message box and no panic hook anywhere in the tree. After this change, a double-click that fails (bad GPU pick, no adapter, panic) shows nothing at all: the "window that never appears" the issue says must not happen. Add a Windows-only visible error path (e.g. `MessageBoxW` from `main` when `run` returns non-zero and no console was attached, plus a panic hook doing the same), or, if you judge that out of scope, say so and get the maintainer's yes, since it changes the issue's "Done means".
3. Where the log goes with no console (expected point 3): the decision note says tracing "keeps writing to a stderr that is simply closed". The issue asks that this be stated and a follow-up filed for a log file; please file that `source:agent` follow-up and name it in the PR body.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Issue "Done means" asks for the subsystem pinned by a PE-header check in `xtask`/packaging and a unit-tested pure part; neither is here. A small `xtask` check reading the Subsystem field of the built `camcraft-ui.exe` would cover it (a PROCESS_VERSION bump is then needed for `xtask/`).
- `cargo run` from a terminal and the UI test harness: tests run the app in-process, so they are unaffected by the subsystem; `cargo run` output depends entirely on item 1.
- Body: `Changelog:` line present, closes only #1278 (`Fixes #1278`); the "PR #M" placeholder in the Changelog line should read #1287. By-hand list for the maintainer: double-click (no console flash), launch from cmd/PowerShell/Git Bash (log appears), `camcraft-ui.exe > log.txt 2>&1` and a pipe (file gets the log), and a forced start-up failure by double-click (e.g. `CAMCRAFT_GPU_BACKEND=bogus` set system-wide) to see something visible.
- Provenance header is present; file is far under 400 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
